snapshot_next_report.description: The 5 October 2026 snapshot's input, rebuilt: 19 names in four themes, movers and headlines.
snapshot_next_report.first_output:
The memory and storage names split sharply today: WDC and STX jumped 5.6% and 4.6%, respectively, each outpacing their peers by more than 5 points, while SNDK and MU both declined nearly 1%. That divergence is unusual for a theme that typically moves together. Elsewhere, the AI compute names ran as a group — TSM, NVDA and AVGO all up 2.1% to 2.8% — with AMD the outlier, flat on the day and 2.5 points behind its peers. Most of mega-cap tech climbed 2% or better, though AAPL slipped 0.3%.

CEG rose 4.1% in the power theme, well ahead of the rest of that group, which moved little. The Nasdaq climbed 0.9%, outpacing the S&P's 0.7% gain, and tech weighted the session.

Off the watchlist, several Brazilian fintech names jumped 20% or more — XP, PAGS, INTR and STNE all appeared on the day's most active and largest gainers. PTC surged 34% and also made both lists.

TSM reports in 10 days. The following week brings TSLA and VRT in 16 days, then STX in 22 days, then a cluster on or around October 28: GEV, GOOGL, META and MSFT all in 23 days, followed by AAPL, AMZN and SNDK in 24 days.
